name: edit_collision_guard
description: Two-step guard: 1) record_read after reading a file 2) check before editing. Detects external modifications. Pairs with edit_transaction.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory.

action.description: record_read: snapshot after reading; check: verify before editing

session_id.description: Optional session ID for multi-agent isolation (default: "default")
